intro:
BATTLE OF PINDUS - 3 NOV 1940

Pindus Mountains, Epirus

In your defense sector an Italian Division tries to advance on the strategic mountain pass at the town of Metsovo and threatens to cut off our supply routes and to separate our troops in Epirus and in Macedonia. Stop the attack and chase away the Italian troops from the Pindus Mountains! Our Cavalry Division will try to surround the enemy on their right flank and encircle the Italians together with your troops.

GOAL Capture all VH!

NOTE The unit occupying the town Vovousa, gets the chance of a Leader!

Morava Mountains, Albania

The Italian attack could be stopped along the entire front! Now we will take the initiative and launch an offensive on the eastern flank of the front. Target of the attack is traffic point Korytsa in Albania. A victory will strengthen the morale of our troops and our nation in general.

GOAL Capture all VH!

RETREAT TO THESSALONIKI - 8 APR 1941

South of Doiran Lake, Central Macedonia

As expected, the Germans invaded our country in support of their unsuccessful Allies, the Italians. German armored forces, through Yugoslavia bypassing the Metaxas Line, are on their way to Thessaloniki and threaten to encircle our East Macedonia Army. I fear that we are not able to stop the Germans here. Withdraw your troops immediately to Thessaloniki and try to establish a new defense line there. Use for your non-motorized units the railway line Kilkis-Thessaloniki to escape the rapid German forces!

GOAL Retreat 22 ground units via Exit Points or hold after the eighth turn 4 VH for BV! Hold after the eighth turn 3 VH or 2 VH for V or TV!

NOTE It is advisable to delay the deployment partly until the second turn, and then to send non-motorized units immediately via train on their journey. In this mission the AI has the first turn!

intro:
LAKE KASTORIA - 15 APR 1941

Lake Kastoria, West Macedonia

As expected, the Germans invaded our country in support of their unsuccessful Allies, the Italians. Our East Macedonia Army capitulated already, our forces in Western Macedonia are destroyed and the Germans are close to Kozani. Thus our main forces in Albania threatens to cut off! We have no other choice but to immediate withdrawal from Albania. Advance with your troops immediately to Lake Kastoria and save our line of retreat!

GOAL Retreat 6 ground units via Exit Point or hold after the ninth turn 4 VH for BV! Hold after the ninth turn 3 VH or 2 VH for V or TV!

South of Grevena, West Macedonia

A German SS unit, passed Lake Kastoria before, is already on their way to Metsovo pass and there is now the opportunity to attack this force from behind! Prevent the blockade of the Metsovo pass and allow further comrades to escape!

Our last operation in the Grammos mountains was a bust! Most rebels escaped in the Vitsi region. Our job is now to prevent a renewed Redoubt in the Vitsi mountains and to destroy the escaped enemy forces. We plan a coordinated attack from the south and east to encircle the rebels. OPERATION TORCH - 24 AUG 1949

East of Mt Grammos, Pindus Mountains

We are on the verge of winning the war! The defeated rebels have been entrenched in the mountains at the Albania border and the General Staff has ordered a last major operation in order to complete our victory. The Americans have supplied us with modern dive bomber and they should help to destroy the strong fortifications. Chase off the remaining communist troops from their fortifications in the Grammos mountains!

intro:
ESCAPE FROM EGYPT - 8 MAY 1943

Military Prison Al-Qabbari, Alexandria

The renowned hero now only a public enemy! Jailed in the military prison of Al-Qabbari you are waiting for your trial because of communist propaganda and insubordination against the Middle East High Command and the Greek government in exile. However, your friends managed to organize your escape to Greece and to provide you with a getaway car. At the airport of Alexandria a plane is ready for take off and alternatively a vessel waiting for you located in the port of Al Muaddiyah. Reach one of these points without to be caught at the control points of the Brits! Friends on the Greek freighters SS Dimitrios Inglessis and SS Thrace monitor the airport and the port for you!

GOAL Retreat your MSU via Exit Point!

Athens, Greece

After the withdrawal of the Germans from Greece, the royalists have returned to our country and think they can - with the help of the disgusting Brits - rob the fruits of our liberation struggle! They also not shy away from massacre peaceful protesters to keep themselves in power. Once again it's time to take up arms and to chase these parasites out of our country!

Our struggle for a free Greece is now entering a decisive phase. Our political leadership has decided that we need a major city as capital for our government to gain further international validity for our fight. The choice has fallen on the city Konitsa at the Albanian border and the battle is already under way. But reinforcements are on the way to Konitsa to relieve the garrison. Fend off the attacks of the Athenian mercenary troops and bring the liberation of Konitsa to a successful end!

Mt Grammos, Pindus Mountains

The battle for the Grammos mountains raged for nearly a month and the Athenian fascists send more and more mercenary troops into battle. We have no choice, we must abandon the Grammos mountains temporarily and dare the breakout! To achieve this, you will carry out a concentrated attack on the center of the enemy forces!
